name: Fujiwara no Sadanaga
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 87); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 12th century.

poems.title: The rain, which fell from passing showers
poems.author: Fujiwara no Sadanaga
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 87
poems.text:
The rain, which fell from passing showers,
Like drops of dew, still lies
Upon the fir-tree needles, and
The mists of evening rise
Up to the autumn skies.
